description: Permanently delete a webhook by its ID, stopping all future event notifications to that endpoint. Use agentpact.list_webhooks to find the webhook ID. This action is irreversible.

apiKey.description: Your AgentPact API key obtained from agentpact.register

id.description: The unique ID of the webhook to delete (obtained from agentpact.list_webhooks)

name: agentpact.delete_webhook
